title: 如何向团队复盘 Disney+ 在 2025 年公布的 Hulu 品牌整合计划？
topic: 向客服与产品团队说明品牌切换时间、界面更新和后续整合

source.title: Hulu Becomes Global General Entertainment Brand on Disney+ Beginning October 8
source.type: Disney+ 官方品牌与产品更新
source.context: 向客服与产品团队说明品牌切换时间、界面更新和后续整合

paragraphs: The power and value of the Hulu brand will reach worldwide audiences beginning October 8, when it becomes the global General Entertainment brand on Disney+, replacing Star in international markets.

With this change, and in preparation for a fully integrated unified app experience next year, users will begin to see further integrations of Hulu across the Disney+ app as part of an ongoing and iterative slate of product updates on the homepage and beyond. This includes a series of design and navigation enhancements rolling out over the coming weeks and months — offering a more dynamic and intuitive experience.

A new navigation bar has been added to the top of the homepage. The “For You” tab is the first screen subscribers will see when they click into Disney+. It’s the new homebase for recommended viewing, powered by an updated algorithm that learns user preferences over time. There are also tabs for Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN, depending on the user’s subscription, making it easier to explore each catalog individually.
translations: 从 10 月 8 日开始，Hulu 品牌将面向全球观众，并成为 Disney+ 的全球综合娱乐品牌，取代国际市场中的 Star。
这一变化是迈向明年完整统一 App 体验的准备步骤。Hulu 将继续整合进 Disney+，主页和导航更新会在接下来数周至数月内逐步推出。
新版导航栏增加了“为你推荐”标签，成为订阅者打开 Disney+ 后看到的首屏。用户也会按自己的订阅看到 Disney+、Hulu 和 ESPN 栏目，分别浏览各自的内容库。
fullTextParagraphs: The power and value of the Hulu brand will reach worldwide audiences beginning October 8, when it becomes the global General Entertainment brand on Disney+, replacing Star in international markets.

With this change, and in preparation for a fully integrated unified app experience next year, users will begin to see further integrations of Hulu across the Disney+ app as part of an ongoing and iterative slate of product updates on the homepage and beyond. This includes a series of design and navigation enhancements rolling out over the coming weeks and months — offering a more dynamic and intuitive experience.
Here’s an early look at what’s coming to Disney+:
Making the user experience more intuitive

A new navigation bar has been added to the top of the homepage. The “For You” tab is the first screen subscribers will see when they click into Disney+. It’s the new homebase for recommended viewing, powered by an updated algorithm that learns user preferences over time. There are also tabs for Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN, depending on the user’s subscription, making it easier to explore each catalog individually.
The Live hub in the main vertical navigation takes you straight into the latest live news, sports, and events, as well as our 24/7 Streams.
We’re also adding new badging tags like “Season Finale,” “New Series,” and “New Movie” to show what’s unique and timely right now.
Helping users easily get to the content they want and discover the content that is most relevant to them

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes to evolve and advance our personalized video algorithm that will learn and improve over time. This will power our recommendation and personalization engine for the content we surface to users across all touchpoints on the platform, especially in the all-new “For You” tab.

To ensure users are watching in their own profile, we’ll make Profiles more prominent across the UI. From here, users will find titles personally recommended for them based on their unique viewing habits.
A more modern design that brings our characters and stories front and center

The new design is more modern and intuitive so users can find and discover the characters and stories they love. This includes a new video display in the Hero carousel and a more dynamic brand row, showcasing the latest titles from each brand. We’ve also updated our content sets to showcase more cinematic poster-style artwork.
While several of these design updates will apply across living room screens, we’re also putting a lot of thought into enhancing the mobile experience.

Widgets are launching on iOS, which will add another front door to take users directly into our programming with one click. And in the year ahead, we’re looking forward to introducing mobile-first and mobile-exclusive experiences that will expand our reach and engage with new audiences.
These enhancements are just the beginning, with additional updates planned in the lead-up to the launch of a unified app experience next year.

scenario.title: 虚构情境练习｜汇报银行 App 的会员专区整合
english: Starting November 4, a bank will replace its separate Rewards page with a single Member hub in its mobile app.
The hub is the first step toward an integrated member experience next year; homepage and navigation updates will roll out over the following weeks.
Customers will see different service tabs based on the products linked to their account. Write a three-sentence update for customer support.
chinese: 从 11 月 4 日开始，一家银行将用统一的“会员中心”取代手机 App 中单独的“奖励”页面。
会员中心是迈向明年整合式会员体验的第一步；主页和导航更新会在接下来数周内逐步推出。
客户会根据自己账户关联的产品看到不同服务标签。请给客服团队写三句话更新。

firstAttempt.prompt: 请向团队复盘 Disney 于 2025 年 10 月 2 日发布的公告：说明 Hulu 何时取代国际市场中的 Star、当时公布的后续更新节奏，以及用户会按什么看到不同栏目。
firstAttempt.sample: In its October 2, 2025 announcement, Disney said Hulu would replace Star as the general-entertainment brand on Disney+ in international markets starting October 8. The company described this as an early step toward a unified app experience planned for 2026, with homepage and navigation updates expected to roll out over the following weeks and months. At the time, subscribers were expected to see Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN tabs based on their subscriptions.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先按公告日期复述品牌切换，再把当时的 2026 整合计划和分阶段更新与已发生的品牌切换区分开。

words.example: The integration will continue over the next year.
words.translation: 这项整合将在明年继续推进。

words.example: The new navigation bar sits at the top of the homepage.
words.translation: 新的导航栏位于主页顶部。

words.example: The available tabs depend on the user’s subscription.
words.translation: 可见栏目取决于用户的订阅。

choice.prompt: 根据 Disney 于 2025 年 10 月发布的公告，哪句准确区分了当月品牌切换和当时规划的后续整合？
options: The unified app launched on October 8, 2025, and Hulu replaced Star in 2026.
Hulu replaced Star on Disney+ in international markets starting October 8, 2025; the company described a unified app as a plan for 2026.
All subscribers received every Disney service tab on October 8, 2025.
choice.why: 第二句把 2025 年 10 月已经宣布实施的品牌切换，与公告当时计划在 2026 年推进的统一 App 区分开。
